تبصبصت (form IIq)
# تَبَصْبَصْتُ (tabaṣbaṣtu) /ta.basˤ.basˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# تَبَصْبَصْتَ (tabaṣbaṣta) /ta.basˤ.basˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# تَبَصْبَصْتِ (tabaṣbaṣti) /ta.basˤ.basˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# تَبَصْبَصَتْ (tabaṣbaṣat) /ta.basˤ.ba.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
